description.value: The Lost Lagoon Nature House is a nature interpretation center operated by Stanley Park Ecology on the southeast shore of Lost Lagoon, right in the heart of Stanley Park — one of Vancouver's most popular cycling destinations. Visitors can explore interactive displays on local ecology, handle real wildlife specimens, and get current trail and wildlife insights from knowledgeable park naturalists. It sits along the inner park cycling routes and seawall, making it a natural and rewarding pause on any Stanley Park bike tour.

OSM contains no phone or address; the Nature House direct phone (604-257-8544) is sourced from the website contact subpage, and the website confirms the OSM URL is correct.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone or address; phone 604-257-8544 (Nature House direct line) is sourced from website contact subpage, not OSM.

Two phone numbers appear on the website: 604-257-6908 (general SPE line, listed on the Nature House page under Contact Us) and 604-257-8544 (Nature House specific, listed on the contact subpage); the more specific Nature House number was used.
No formal civic street address exists for the Nature House itself; the SPE office at 610 Pipeline Road is a separate location. Descriptive location used.
Seasonal accessibility note: water barriers installed November–February make wheelchair and mobility access difficult — not relevant to cyclist criteria but worth flagging for directory accuracy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Nature House is a well-established attraction inside Stanley Park, a premier cycling destination in Vancouver; it offers a genuinely interesting stop for touring cyclists and is clearly active and publicly accessible.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Nature House is a separate physical location from the Stanley Park Ecology Society office at 610 Pipeline Road. Accessibility is partially limited by an unpaved path and seasonal flood barriers.

wow_evidence: Free Stanley Park Ecology Society interpretation centre — wildlife specimens, naturalists on hand; family-friendly quick stop.
blurb: Free nature house on Lost Lagoon with wildlife displays and park naturalists.
